note: Stage 4: the order does not matter. Three rows of four blocks turn a quarter turn into four rows of three, then two plates of three strawberries become three plates of two. Quiz: pick the pair of sentences that both work / drag the missing factor / listen and pick the matching sentence.

lines.text: Here are three rows and four columns. That is three times four. Twelve blocks!
Now we have four rows and three columns. Four times three is also twelve!
Three times four equals four times three.
Two times three is six. Three times two is also six.
Drag the number that makes it match.
